signals.title: Synthetic export remains queued after reconnect
signals.observed: In a fictional demo service, an export submitted while disconnected still displayed queued after reconnect. Refreshing the page showed it completed.
signals.expected: The displayed export state updates after reconnect without a manual refresh.
reproduction: Open the fictional export dashboard and disconnect its demo transport.
Submit an export, reconnect, and compare the displayed state before and after refresh.
signals.environment: Synthetic web client 0.4, simulated reconnect; browser version not recorded.
signals.reported_impact: One synthetic test session needed a manual refresh. No customer or business impact is established.

signals.title: Synthetic completed export still appears queued
signals.observed: A second authored report describes a queued label after a simulated reconnect, with a completed result visible after refresh. No trace is supplied to link it to S01.

signals.title: Synthetic download fails despite completed state
signals.observed: The demo dashboard displayed completed before a simulated download returned 404. No reconnect was reported. This may be a separate problem, not another instance of the queued-label symptom.
signals.expected: A completed synthetic export can be downloaded.
signals.environment: Synthetic web client 0.4; result retention configuration unknown.
